g.text: Illustrative pathways — no probabilities or recovery-time estimates
If power and transport return and equipment survives, production can restart.
Recovery duration and lost output depend on damage and inventories.
If fabs, packaging or logistics remain disrupted, shipments may be constrained.
Existing Arizona wafer production is real; available replacement volume is unknown.
If access to Taiwan is broadly lost, multiple supply steps can fail together.
Recovery timing and revenue effects cannot be inferred from expansion targets.
Published targets: Japan substrate plant 3x; Korea interposer capacity >300% increase.
These are different processes and baselines, not measured substitute GPU capacity.
Sources: NVIDIA announcements; NVIDIA FY2026 filing. Targets are not guarantees.
